# Nested collection results with an invariant classifier

Independently authored Java8 factories retain Collection<E>, Classifier<E> and
both invariant layers of List<List<E>>. The frozen observer checks exact input
and classifier references, iterator actions, partial failures, opaque outer and
inner lists, ignored calls and delayed casts. All source/SDK output units compile
with original Signatures, definitions, roles, Exceptions and helpers compared.
Private application bytes and behavior are excluded from these fixtures.
